a: $250,000 unrestricted to one laureate per category; $15,000 to each of 5 finalists
dt: Nomination period Oct 7–Dec 2, 2026; age-exception requests by Nov 11, 2026; letters of support due Dec 16, 2026.
e: Tenured or tenure-track faculty (or equivalent) with a doctorate who are active PIs at a US institution. Age rule for 2027: born in or after 1985* (the cutoff moves one year each cycle; it was 1984 for 2026). *Age-limit exceptions are considered only in exceptional circumstances, on a detailed written request from Yale to the NY Academy of Sciences by Nov 11, 2026. Yale nominates one person per category (Life Sciences, Physical Sciences & Engineering, Chemical Sciences). No citizenship requirement stated; unsuccessful past nominees can be re-nominated.
f: Blavatnik Family Foundation / NY Academy of Sciences
n: Blavatnik National Awards for Young Scientists (2027)
unv: Blavatnik's guidelines page still shows the 2026 cycle (born in or after 1984*); the 2027 cutoff of 1985 is from the 2027 nomination portal and university notices (CU Boulder, Vanderbilt).

yale.t: Yale limited submission: internal application due Oct 28, 2026 on InfoReady. Questions: internal.proposals@yale.edu.
